source: Eastern street views, each 800 × 600 native pixels, registered independently on the south C and E window banks. The 2015 branch crosses the middle light and foliage masks the lower face.
method: The rounded front roof corner is triangulated in four registered winter observations (eastern-roof-four-stations.json). The farther visible roof point is the mean intersection of its two eastern-view rays at the same cap elevation. The three side lights are intersected with the vertical plane between these points. Their jambs and heads are averaged across readable stations. Only 2015 has a complete middle-window reading; the 2020 center in branches documents the occlusion.
